verdict.rationale: Structured scorecards are a fair question for an ATS like Lever, but the evidence pack never mentions scorecards, per-stage attributes, interviewer rubrics, or cross-candidate comparison. The AI-generated interview guide and AI transcripts/summaries are adjacent features (question generation and note capture), not structured scoring, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews are scored on structured scorecards — defined attributes per stage, focused rubrics per interviewer, comparable across candidates
